lead_html: Low Pygmy is a minor sound with a deep ding. Every card here is built on the i chord, F minor: play each card's lit notes, then move to the next.
alias_html: Also sold as F minor Low Pygmy.
history_html: F Low Pygmy 9 puts a ding on F2, an octave below the usual F3. Eight notes sit around it on the top shell: F G Ab C Eb F G Ab. That is the five notes of F minor pentatonic. One maker lists it as an F2 Low Pygmy in F minor, with the notes F F G G# C D# F G G#. Makers differ on the exact notes and octaves, so check your own pan.
og_description: F Low Pygmy 9 handpan chords: chord cards with the notes to play, then practice in the free chord flashcard app.
